format: OhMyPi v3 session JSONL; optional title-slot v1

v3.jsonl.normalization: Skip the physical title slot and session header as conversational messages; retain exact user/assistant text blocks; classify message.role=toolResult as tool result, not user text; exclude thinking and branch summaries.

tool_turns.jsonl.normalization: Assistant textSignature phase is message metadata; keep user/assistant text blocks only. Tool calls/results are excluded from conversation text. Link toolResult by toolCallId only to a matching call on the parentId ancestry path; turn_id is the nearest user-message ancestor-or-self. Repeated call IDs in another branch/turn are not global matches. Malformed complete JSONL is warned and retained as an unknown record; the incomplete final line is not observed.
